payload.title: File:Simonettoia tilaventina (holotype, trunk and pelvis).png
payload.artist_html: S. Renesto, F. Saller, F. M. Dalla Vecchia
payload.credit_html: "'Simonettoia tilaventina, a new tanystropheid (Diapsida Archosauromorpha) from the Upper Triassic (Norian) of northeastern Italy"
payload.description_html: Simonettoia tilaventina, MFSN 24992, holotype. Distal half of the trunk and sacrum with the pelvis. Abbreviations: dr, dorsal ribs; is, ischium; fe, femur; il, ilium; is, ischium; lb, fused ‘lumbar rib’; lv1-3, ‘lumbar’ vertebrae 1-3; pu, pubis; sr1, sacral rib1; sv1-2, sacral vertebrae 1-2. Right elements are in brackets.
